subject: Procurement kickoff and onboarding - StellarHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Stellar Health Procurement <procurement@stellarhealth.com>; Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@healthops.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:07:12 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff and onboarding - StellarHealth

Hi Stella / Alex —

Congrats again on selecting Redwood for inference. To keep procurement and security review moving, can we schedule a 60-minute procurement/onboarding kickoff next week? Goal: align on contracting timeline, procurement checklist, technical onboarding owners (CE/SE), and the evidence items your InfoSec team will want (SOC 2, data flows, retention, KMS).

Suggested windows (PST):
- Tue 6/30, 10:00–11:00
- Wed 7/1, 14:00–15:00
- Thu 7/2, 11:00–12:00

Proposed attendees from our side: myself (AE), Dev Patel (Solutions Engineer), Stephanie Nguyen (Customer Success/Onboarding). Please let me know who from your procurement and security teams should be included. I attached our onboarding checklist and a draft SOW to help scope the conversation.

If it’s easier, pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/60min-onboarding

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0118

Attachments: Redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx, Stellar_SOW_v1.pdf

From: Stellar Health Procurement <procurement@stellarhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@healthops.com>
Cc: Erin Cho <erin.cho@stellarhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 12:45:03 -0400
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff and onboarding - StellarHealth

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — we’d like to do a kickoff. Our procurement lead (me) and InfoSec (Erin) should be on the call. Alex (engineering) will join as well. Of the slots you suggested the two that work for us are:
- Wed 7/1, 14:00 PST
- Thu 7/2, 11:00 PST

Quick items we want on the agenda:
- Contract redline owner and timing (we use DocuSign; please confirm point of contact)
- SOC 2 report and scope (is there any scoped-out data flow?)
- Data retention and KMS (customer-managed key options)
- Onboarding timeline and access (service accounts, network allowlists)

Can you also share who will be handling the commercial/finance contact for billing and PO?

Best,
Stella Ramos
Procurement Lead | Stellar Health
procurement@stellarhealth.com

Note: Erin (InfoSec) will send our standard questionnaire ahead of the call.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:10:44 -0700

Hi Stella —

Thanks — we’ll take Wed 7/1 14:00 PST (60m). I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda. Attendees confirmed from Redwood: myself (AE) + Dev Patel (SE) + Stephanie (CS/onboarding). On the commercial side, I’ll loop in our finance contact (Rachel Kim) on the contract thread so she can handle PO/redline questions.

Quick notes for the call so your team can prepare:
- We’ll bring our SOC 2 scope and an evidence packet; Erin is welcome to request any additional artifacts after kickoff.
- KMS: we support customer-managed keys via our KMS integration — Dev will walk through options.
- Network/access: we’ll cover allowlist requirements and service account provisioning.

Attachments: I re-attached the onboarding checklist.

Marissa
